description_en: Restores a file or directory from the recycle bin
description_zh: 恢复一个暂存回收站中的文件
name: CreateRecycleBinRestoreJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the file or directory that you want to restore.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412174.html operation to query the FileId of the deleted data
parameters.help_zh:
待恢复的文件或目录的FileId。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412174.html接口查询已删除数据的FileId信息
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the directory to which the file is restored.

*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412173.html operation to query the TargetFileId for recently deleted directories.
*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412163.html operation to query the TargetFileId for existing directories
parameters.help_zh:
文件恢复后所存储目录的FileId。
- 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412173.html接口查询执行过删除操作的目录TargetFileId信息。

- 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412163.html接口查询文件系统中已存在目录TargetFileId信息
parameters.name: target_file_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

>若您未指定ClientToken，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
